## Checklist

- [ ] Data is anonymized (no PII, credentials, or org names) — or, for a `"disclosure": "public"` incident, organizations are named only as the affected party and every claim is backed by `source_urls`
- [ ] Entries reference at least one DSGAI ID where applicable
- [ ] Validation scripts pass (`python data_validation/run_all_checks.py`)
- [ ] One entry per file for dataset contributions
